'''Proton Torpedo Launchers''' were [[Crawler (vehicle)|crawler-type]] anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] mobile [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] platforms that could fire [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] from a [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|launch tube]] it deployed during combat. Constructed in [[Heavy Weapons Factory|heavy weapons factories]] at a cost of 150 units of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] and 50 units of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species during the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Proton Torpedo Launchers and [[Proton Torpedo Launcher (Wookiee)|Heavy Proton Torpedo Launchers]] appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The campaign was later included in its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]]. An image of a Proton Torpedo Launcher was used to represent the "anti-air mobile" unit in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]''.
